1. Zhonghua Er Bi Yan Hou Tou Jing Wai Ke Za Zhi. 2026 Aug 7;61(8):944-948. doi: 
10.3760/cma.j.cn115330-20260129-00070.

[The mechanisms of auditory information processing in the medial geniculate body 
and their relationship to tinnitus perception].

[Article in Chinese; Abstract available in Chinese from the publisher]

Guo BT(1), Huo Y(1), Zhang JN(1).

Author information:
(1)Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Yueyang Hospital of Integrated Traditional 
Chinese and Western Medicine, Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese 
Medicine, Shanghai 200437, China.

Publisher: 
耳鸣是无明确相应外部声源时的声音感知，其发生与听觉信息在丘脑水平的加工处理过程密切相关。内侧膝状体不仅是听觉信息传递的重要中继站，更承担着听觉信号门控、筛选与整合的功能。本文阐述内侧膝状体如何通过其精细解剖分区与复杂神经环路，动态调控听觉上行与下行信号，以及在听力损失等病理条件下，其信号门控与中枢增益障碍参与耳鸣感知形成的过程。.

DOI: 10.3760/cma.j.cn115330-20260129-00070
